# PomodoFocus — Minimalist Pomodoro Timer with Ambient Lofi Soundscapes

> PomodoFocus is a free, modern, privacy-first Pomodoro timer and productivity application designed with Scandinavian and Japanese Zen minimalism. It combines deep-work time management with built-in 24/7 ambient lofi and jazz radio streams integrated into an organic Dynamic Island interface.

## Quick Facts
- **Website**: https://pomodofocus.vercel.app
- **Category**: Productivity, Deep Work, Study Timer, Time Tracking
- **Pricing**: 100% Free (No ads, no subscriptions, no accounts)
- **Privacy**: Local-first (All tasks, settings, and session stats stored in browser localStorage; zero user tracking)
- **Platform**: Web (Desktop, Mobile, Tablet; PWA installable; Picture-in-Picture supported)

## Key Features
- **Integrated Ambient Soundscapes**: 4 live streaming radio stations (Lofi 24/7, Chillhop Radio, Smooth Chill, Coffee Shop Vibes) playable directly within a single-path fluid droplet Dynamic Island.
- **Dynamic Island Liquid Meniscus**: Seamless Apple-inspired Dynamic Island player with two-line typography, rotating vinyl disc badge, and one-tap controls.
- **Customizable Intervals**: Default 25m Focus / 5m Short Break / 15m Long Break with customizable intervals.
- **Focus Presets**: Pre-configured workflows including Classic Pomodoro, Extended Deep Work (50m/10m), Quick Sprints (15m/3m), and Ultraworking (90m/20m).
- **Task Management**: Built-in task list with Pomodoro count estimates, completion tracking, and active session assignment.
- **Session Ratings & Analytics**: Post-session productivity ratings (1-5), daily completion heatmaps, and weekly focus metrics.
- **Picture-in-Picture (PiP)**: Floating mini timer window via Document Picture-in-Picture API for seamless multi-window workflow.
- **Audio Ducking**: Automatically attenuates background soundscapes when completion chimes play.

## Methodology: The Pomodoro Technique
1. Choose a single task to work on.
2. Start a 25-minute Pomodoro focus session.
3. Work with uninterrupted attention until the timer sounds.
4. Take a restorative 5-minute short break.
5. Every 4 completed Pomodoros, take an extended 15-to-30 minute long break to maintain cognitive stamina.

## Keyboard Shortcuts
- `Space`: Start / Pause timer
- `R`: Reset current interval
- `S`: Skip to next interval (Focus / Short Break / Long Break)
- `M`: Toggle ambient audio playback
- `F`: Toggle full screen focus mode
